description: Angela Wright responds to Patricia Hawkins's directive to cross-reference workers who departed this month against the transition program enrollment list. Angela confirms receipt of the directive and provides an active status update: she is running the cross-reference now, will complete personal outreach calls to all unenrolled departed workers within 48 hours, and will cite Patricia's name explicitly in each outreach. She will inform each person of the $2,500 grant threshold reduction to 10% for auto row businesses, the First Community Bank small-dollar products via David Chen, and the Millfield Community College enrollment window. Angela also communicates that the formal stay bonus eligibility memo is going out to all remaining staff this same tick — the written terms Jake and Tamika were waiting on. She is tracking all transition outreach contacts and outcomes in a log she will share with Patricia. The message to Patricia is: I am executing your directive, the stay bonus documentation is done, and I am treating the people who departed as individuals who deserve a real path.
expected_outcome: Trust between hr_director and ceo_regional_auto holds or increases. Patricia receives confirmation that her transition directive is being executed. Angela's professional standing with Patricia is reinforced. The departed workers gain a direct outreach channel with Patricia's authority behind it. Angela's transition methodology pipeline gains documented operational credibility.
